invariants.name: complete-joint-outcome-space
invariants.expected: each hypothesis defines all 2^m binary patterns exactly once

invariants.name: normalized-conditional-distributions
invariants.expected: joint probabilities per hypothesis are finite, bounded and sum to one

invariants.name: selected-subset-marginalization
invariants.expected: unselected outcomes are summed out from the declared joint distribution

invariants.name: no-order-dependent-semantics
invariants.expected: candidate ordering plus corresponding pattern-bit permutation yields identical semantic results

invariants.name: independence-bias-is-visible
invariants.expected: the evaluator reports exact joint EVSI and the naive conditional-independence comparator separately

invariants.name: adaptive-sequential-decision-policy
invariants.expected: after each result, compare expected continuation utility net of acquisition cost against stopping and making the best current decision

invariants.name: conditional-correlation-aware-follow-up
invariants.expected: follow-up observation likelihoods are conditioned on all prior outcomes through the complete joint distribution

invariants.name: joint-single-survey-marginal-consistency
invariants.expected: the declared marginal likelihood for every sensor/hypothesis equals the marginal induced by the complete joint outcome table

negativeControls.mutation: Change a joint probability so its per-hypothesis distribution no longer sums to one.
negativeControls.reason: Unnormalized likelihood tables cannot define valid posterior probabilities.
The joint outcome space must be complete; missing patterns are not assumed to have zero probability.

negativeControls.mutation: Add a non-binary character or an outcome pattern of the wrong length.
negativeControls.reason: Observation patterns must map unambiguously to the frozen survey inventory.

negativeControls.mutation: Treat a perfectly correlated second survey as independent after observing the first.
negativeControls.reason: The policy value must condition the next observation on the entire observed history.

negativeControls.mutation: Continue acquiring a correlated repeat observation when its conditional expected decision gain is zero and its cost is positive.
negativeControls.reason: Sequential planning must compare expected continuation value with stopping.

negativeControls.mutation: Change a single-survey positive likelihood without changing the corresponding joint outcome distribution.
negativeControls.reason: The benchmark must isolate dependence assumptions rather than compare different marginal sensor models.

baselines: naive product of marginal likelihoods (known-invalid comparator when dependence exists)
